question: What fix does each P3 class receive, on what evidence surface, and what may a fix worker NOT do?
general_constraints: Fixers execute adjudicated verdicts; they NEVER re-adjudicate, soften, or expand a verdict. If a directive cannot be applied faithfully, emit status NOT-FIXED with a concrete reason — do not improvise.

Cache-only: no CourtListener or web calls in any fix lane. Evidence surfaces are the lake (_overhaul2/lake/), the rendered content pages (content/), the points registry, and the packet's vote extracts. Anything genuinely requiring fresh legal verification -> NOT-FIXED (orchestrator routes to the serial CL lane or _review-needed/).
Write scope: a worker edits ONLY files listed in its packet. Reading anything is fine.
No new legal assertions: fixes may narrow, qualify, retarget, restore from lake-verified text, or correct plumbing — never introduce a proposition the lake does not already verify.
Identity re-keys (cluster_id/lead_opinion_id changes) are NOT sanctioned in fix lanes -> NOT-FIXED with the proposed target for orchestrator action.
Lake JSON edits must preserve schema validity (_overhaul2/lake/_schema.json): quote_fidelity in {matched,not_checked,mismatch}; pinpoint_status in {star-verified,slip-only}.

classes.qf-harvest-artifact: Per P2-QF-RULING (i): the stored pinpoints[].quote is corrupt (harvested content-page markdown), while the rendered page quote was opus-verified verbatim-faithful. Fix: in the lake record, replace the corrupt quote with the rendered page's quotation body for that pin (the blockquote anchored ^pin-<id>, attribution line excluded); set page/star_marker from the pin id or the page's attribution (e.g. '476 U.S. at 215' -> page 215); set quote_fidelity='matched'; pinpoint_status: 'star-verified' only when a reporter star page is confirmed by the attribution, slip pins stay 'slip-only'. If the rendered page has no anchored quote for that pin -> NOT-FIXED.
classes.quote-fidelity: Tally-UPHELD quote defects. Same re-harvest mechanic as qf-harvest-artifact where the rendered page carries a verified anchored quote. Where it does not, apply the adjudicated fallback: remove the verbatim-quote claim — set quote to null equivalent permitted by schema is NOT available (quote is required), so instead set quote_fidelity='not_checked', pinpoint_status='slip-only', and replace the corrupt payload with the shortest faithful paraphrase-free excerpt ONLY if one exists on the rendered page; otherwise NOT-FIXED with reason 'no verified source text in cache'.
classes.qf-pin-drift: Per P2-QF-RULING (iii): the quote is verbatim; the pin targets the wrong page/star marker. Retarget the pin exactly per the finding's proposed_fix (lake record and, where the rendered page shows the same drifted pincite, the page attribution too).
classes.home-mirror: The case is homed/rostered under the wrong doctrine family (or with an inapt role) per the adjudicated holding. Move/relabel per the finding: fix the case page's home/role frontmatter and the affected doctrine pages' rosters so home vs mirror placement matches the opinion's actual doctrinal home. Preserve the N6 convention (key-status is non-exclusive; a mirror listing is allowed where the adjudication says mirror-only). Both sides of a swap must stay consistent.
classes.truncated-holding: The page states a holding cut off mid-scope. Restore the full holding per the finding's proposed_fix using ONLY lake-verified content (the record's holding/treatment fields and verified pin quotes). If the needed language is not lake-verified -> NOT-FIXED.
classes.cite-selector: Wrong reporter selector (Fla. L. Weekly instead of the canonical reporter, anachronistic L.Ed.2d parallels, etc.). Replace with the canonical citation from the lake record's citations block. Purely mechanical; no substantive text changes.
classes.treatment-noise: Categorical treatment phrasing overstates certainty (e.g. 'No negative treatment' where the lake carries proposed negative edges or audit flags). Adopt the tightened framing from the packet's stands-modified vote extracts (suggested_tightening / reasons). The good-law call itself stands — do not change the treatment verdict, only qualify the phrasing.
classes.date-drift: date_decided carries a CL date_filed artifact (rehearing/cert dates). Correct to the true decision date per the finding + lake evidence (precedent: F-S9-IDS-002).
classes.alt-cluster-link: An opinion link points at an alternate cluster. Point it at the lake record's identity.absolute_url / canonical cluster. Mechanical.
classes.weight-label: The 6-tier authority-weight label conflicts with the lake record. Set the label to the lake-derived tier per the adjudicated holding.
classes.identity-miskey: Caption/docket/display inconsistencies adjudicated as real (NOT re-keys): fix the display surface (caption, docket string) to the lake canonical identity. Any fix that would require changing cluster/opinion ids -> NOT-FIXED (orchestrator lane).
classes.holding-substance: Substantive accuracy defects on pages: apply the adjudicated holding's directive (individual rows carry reasoned directives; tally rows defer to proposed_fix). Default posture is NARROW/QUALIFY to what the lake verifies, never assert beyond it. If the proposed fix requires evidence the cache lacks -> NOT-FIXED.
classes.registry-12a: Registry black-letter nodes flagged 'cannot verify from disclosed evidence' (panel disclosure did not include the lake; the lake mostly DOES verify these). Fix = substantiate-from-lake: for each flagged node, check every case cited in its statement against the lake (record exists, status verified, holding/pin support tracks the statement). Where fully supported: record the substantiation in the fix row's verification field (record ids + what supports what) — the registry node itself is NOT edited (status stays draft; S7 owns promotion). Where the statement overshoots or a cited case is missing/stub: narrow the statement per the finding's proposed_fix, or NOT-FIXED if narrowing would require judgment beyond the verdict.
classes.individual: Orchestrator-reasoned verdicts from the P2 escalate queue: the adjudicated_holding IS the directive; apply it exactly. Where it references vote framings, the packet's vote extracts carry them.

loop_protocol: Fix rows are flat s9.fix.v1 {schema, finding_id, loop, author:{lane,model}, change_summary, verification, status: FIXED|NOT-FIXED, at}. NOT-FIXED items return to the orchestrator: loop 2 re-dispatch with a clarified directive, loop 3 final; still unresolved -> _review-needed/ escalation (check_ledger counts both surfaces).
scope: All 487 P3-QUEUE items. Registry items in packets R-shard-* take the registry-12a directive when their class is holding-substance.
